objective: Strengthen the Triceratops reference gate after reviewing that the current primary still has weak head and frill proportions, while avoiding the earlier rhinoceros-drift failure.

currentPrimaryKept.reason: Still the safest app-facing full-body candidate: it avoids the obvious rhinoceros body plan, keeps a long tail and four readable dinosaur limbs, and shows the brow horns, short nasal horn cue, closed beak, and skull-frill intent.

newReferenceGuide.purpose: Structure target for the next ControlNet, i2i, or mini-LoRA pass. It emphasizes a skull-attached frill behind the head, exactly two brow horns plus one shorter nasal horn, a closed beak, a long tail, four dinosaur limbs, and visible non-hoofed toes.

newSweep.method: IP-Adapter + ControlNet using the current primary as a low-weight style reference and the new ceratopsian guide as the control source
newSweep.reasonRejected: No output beat the current primary. The sweep drifted into lizard-like heads, frill/back structures, armor-like torsos, or rhino-like body mass.

nextRecommendation: Do not continue broad prompt-only or broad ControlNet sweeps for Triceratops. Use the new guide to build a small ceratopsian head/frill mini-LoRA or a narrower two-stage workflow: full-body structure first, then tiny head/frill masks that do not touch the legs or torso.
